title: Commission sends Statement of Objections to KKR for providing incorrect or misleading information during merger investigation
content: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Oct 2026 The European Commission has informed KKR & Co. Inc. ('KKR') of its preliminary view that the company provided incorrect and/or misleading information during the 2024 Commission's investigation of KKR's acquisition of NetCo, under the EU Merger Regulation ('EUMR').
